sim13_clock_cum_def_epa.description: Opponent EPA per play vs defence snaps so far per 10, within-quarter clock control, game-by-defence FE
sim13_clock_cum_def_epa.notes: unit2 25 looks; placebo with same control +0.0103 [-0.0017,0.0225]; quarter splits still move together
sim13_clock_cum_def_epa.plain_summary: With within-quarter clock control defence snaps still raise opponent EPA, but placebo shrinks the gap to about 0.02.

sim13_def_fatigue_cum_def_epa.description: Opponent EPA per play vs defence cumulative snaps defended at drive start, per 10 snaps, game-by-defence fixed effect
sim13_def_fatigue_cum_def_epa.notes: 28 looks; quarter splits are within-quarter time artifacts (placebo matches)
sim13_def_fatigue_cum_def_epa.plain_summary: Offence gains about 0.02 EPA per play per 10 extra defender snaps within a game; placebo own-offence snaps is -0.002.

sim13_def_fatigue_placebo_cum_off_epa.description: Placebo: offence own cumulative snaps vs its EPA per play, per 10 snaps

sim13_dose_top_tercile_epa.description: Top-tercile slope (>38 snaps) of opponent EPA per play per 10 defended snaps
sim13_dose_top_tercile_epa.notes: lower terciles -0.0068, +0.0051; placebo top +0.0148; nonlinear, concentrated above 38 snaps
sim13_dose_top_tercile_epa.plain_summary: Effect shows mainly after about 38 defended snaps; flat below.

sim13_drive_points_against.description: Points scored on drive vs defence snaps so far per 10, drive level
sim13_drive_points_against.notes: placebo -0.2521 [-0.3152,-0.1957]; main minus placebo about +0.15 points; drive-level outcome has no time control beyond el
sim13_drive_points_against.plain_summary: Drive points against fall with snaps defended, but offence's own snaps fall more; no fatigue read at drive level.

sim13_unit3_diff_loose_above38.description: Defence snaps minus own-offence snaps above 38 snaps, baseline controls, same plays
sim13_unit3_diff_loose_above38.plain_summary: Above the knot the defence-load slope is not distinguishable from its own offence's snaps; strong-control version flips sign (+0.163) because the two counts are 98 percent collinear, so the difference is not identified.

sim13_unit3_diff_strong_above38.description: Same, with drive-index FE and score-by-time controls
sim13_unit3_diff_strong_above38.plain_summary: Sign flips with controls; collinearity R2 0.98; LOSO folds all about 0.16 but unidentified.
